$comment: L2H-01-CTX-CHART: ctx chart rows (on-chart). Supersedes the L2E-05 all-skipped verdict: the ledger binds every ctx.chart* row's WO surface to 'Chart Design Chart elements>… (chartElement <flag>)' (ledger evidence strings), and the runner now supports exactly that two-step: pre 'chart-selection' injects an img.vector-object[data-kind=chart] fixture and left-clicks it (lastChartPick set, contextual chart-design tab unhides + activates), the row selector clicks the 'Chart elements ▾' rb-menu trigger (editor.js:10682-10686 discloses ul.menu-list), and ov.post (runner contract-runner.cjs:546-547) clicks the disclosed menu item 250ms later — each button[role=menuitem][data-cmd=chartElement] has a direct click listener routing through runCommand -> toggleChartElement (editor.js:10688-10693, 1510-1512). With the fixture chart selected, toggleChartElement (editor.js:13710-13722) flips spec.elements[<flag>] and rerenderChart -> reloadVectorTarget rewrites img[data-spec] — asserted as dom-mutation on #fixture-chart[data-spec*=…]. Item values verified in index.html:889-898: title|legend|gridlines|dataLabels|axes|axisTitles|trendline|errorBars|upDownBars|dataTable. Pure ctx-menu rows still don't exist in WO (#ctx-menu has no chart-element data-ctx rows), so the chart-design controls ARE the ledger's stated WO surface for these ids.

ctx.axis-titles.note: ledger row: ctx.axis-titles (WO surface: Chart Design Chart elements>Axis Titles, chartElement axisTitles) — pre chart-selection selects the fixture chart and activates the contextual tab; trigger click discloses the Chart elements rb-menu (editor.js:10682-10686); post click on the axisTitles menuitem (index.html:894) runs runCommand -> toggleChartElement('axisTitles') which flips spec.elements.axisTitles and rerenderChart rewrites img[data-spec] (editor.js:13710-13722) — dom-mutation on [data-spec*="axisTitles"] (absent from the pristine fixture spec, robust to the runner's retry double-toggle since true/false both match)

ctx.chart-title.note: ledger row: ctx.chart-title (chartElement title) — same two-step as ctx.axis-titles; toggleChartElement writes spec.elements.title (editor.js:13718-13720). Assertion anchors on 'elements":{"title' because the pristine fixture spec already contains a top-level "title":"Fixture" — elements:{"title only exists after the toggle (and matches both on/off, surviving the retry double-toggle)

ctx.data-labels.note: ledger row: ctx.data-labels (chartElement dataLabels, index.html:892) — same two-step; toggleChartElement flips spec.elements.dataLabels and rerenderChart rewrites img[data-spec] (editor.js:13710-13722); type-agnostic (not in CHART_ELEMENT_SUPPORT, editor.js:13705) so the fixture bar chart toggles for real

ctx.chart.datatable.note: ledger row: ctx.chart.datatable (WO surface per ledger: 'chartElement dataTable toggle renders data table in chartSVG', index.html:898) — same two-step; toggleChartElement flips spec.elements.dataTable and rerenderChart re-renders chartSVG with the data table while reloadVectorTarget rewrites img[data-spec] (editor.js:13710-13722)

ctx.error-bars.note: ledger row: ctx.error-bars (chartElement errorBars, index.html:896) — same two-step; CHART_ELEMENT_SUPPORT allows errorBars on bar charts (editor.js:13705) so the fixture bar chart toggles spec.elements.errorBars for real (dom-mutation on img[data-spec], editor.js:13710-13722)

ctx.gridlines.note: ledger row: ctx.gridlines (chartElement gridlines, index.html:891) — the chart-element toggle, NOT the document-gridlines #btn-gridlines view row (that one is owned by the view wave under its own key); same two-step, spec.elements.gridlines flipped + img[data-spec] rewritten (editor.js:13710-13722)

ctx.legend.note: ledger row: ctx.legend (chartElement legend, index.html:890) — same two-step; type-agnostic so the fixture bar chart toggles spec.elements.legend for real (editor.js:13705, 13710-13722)

ctx.edit-data.note: ledger row: ctx.edit-data (WO surface per ledger: 'Chart Design tab chartEditData -> openVectorEditor(chart)') — WO keeps Edit data on the chart-design tab (chartEditData), no ctx-menu copy exists; pre chart-selection makes editSelectedChartData() reach openVectorEditor("chart", spec, img) which opens #chart-dialog and fills type select, title input and #chart-data grid (editor.js:13723-13728) — same proven path as chart-tab2.json charteditdata, contracted here under its own ledger id
